categories.main_business_segments: Jilin OLED Material Tech Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main segments: OLED key functional materials and evaporation source equipment. The materials segment includes organic light-emitting materials and other functional materials essential for OLED panel manufacturing. The equipment segment focuses on the research, development, manufacturing, sales, and after-sales service of evaporation source devices, which are core components of OLED panel vacuum evaporation machines.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced molecular design and synthesis technologies for organic light-emitting materials, including high-efficiency electron transport materials, hole transport materials, and phosphorescent materials. It also develops PSPI (photosensitive polyimide) materials, encapsulation materials, and perovskite materials. For equipment, it specializes in high-precision, high-stability evaporation source technology with precise temperature control and uniform material deposition, supporting 6th and 8.6th generation AMOLED production lines. Manufacturing involves vacuum evaporation and advanced coating techniques.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major domestic OLED panel manufacturers such as BOE, Tianma, and others. The company serves the consumer electronics market, including smartphones (especially OLED smartphones and foldable phones), laptops, tablets, automotive displays, and emerging AR/VR microdisplays. The company’s products support both small and medium-to-large size OLED display markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with headquarters and major subsidiaries located in Changchun and Shanghai. It also has a research institute in Japan. Its customer base and sales are predominantly domestic, with over 99% of revenue generated within China. The company maintains some overseas operations and investments but with minimal overseas revenue exposure.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jilin OLED Material Tech is positioned upstream in the OLED industry supply chain, focusing on the production of key OLED functional materials and core equipment components (evaporation sources) essential for OLED panel manufacturing. It supplies critical inputs to panel manufacturers, who then produce OLED display panels for downstream device manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment in OLED materials and equipment, focusing on enhancing material performance (efficiency, stability, color purity) and developing next-generation materials such as blue phosphorescent materials, encapsulation materials, PSPI, and perovskite materials. It also advances evaporation source technology for 8.6 generation AMOLED lines and develops MicroOLED and perovskite evaporation equipment. The company emphasizes patent portfolio expansion, collaboration with academic and industry partners, and alignment with national strategic initiatives to promote OLED industry localization and innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of OLED key functional materials and evaporation source equipment to panel manufacturers. The materials segment uses direct sales and consignment sales models, while equipment sales are conducted through bidding and direct contracts, including installation and after-sales services. The company also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in OLED materials and evaporation source equipment, successfully breaking foreign monopolies in key materials and equipment segments. It competes with international giants like UDC, Samsung, LG Chem, and others in materials, and with Japanese and Korean firms in equipment. Domestically, it holds a dominant position as the sole supplier of 6th generation evaporation source equipment and is expanding its presence in 8.6 generation equipment markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 533 million, a 3% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 90 million, down 26%. R&D investment accounted for 28.15% of revenue, reflecting a growth in innovation spending. The company has a total asset base of around RMB 2.18 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.74 billion. It has maintained steady revenue growth in materials over five consecutive years, while equipment revenue declined due to industry transition from 6th to 8.6 generation lines.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jilin OLED Material Tech emphasizes its deep technological expertise and innovation capabilities in OLED materials and equipment, offering high-purity, high-efficiency, and stable OLED functional materials that meet stringent panel manufacturer requirements. Its evaporation source equipment features high precision, stability, and uniformity, supporting domestic panel makers’ transition to advanced generation lines. The company’s products enable domestic OLED industry localization, reduce reliance on foreign suppliers, and provide customized solutions with strong customer collaboration, securing a competitive edge in the rapidly evolving OLED market.
